# East Star Landscape Maintenance

> Landscaping & Irrigation in St. George, UT. Sod, sprinkler systems, drip lines and backyard redos in St. George. Levi answers the phone, gives a fair price, and his crew does neat, thorough work.

## Services
- Sod: New sod laid and cut neatly around rock and plants.
- Sprinklers & irrigation: Whole sprinkler systems installed, zones tested and tuned.
- Drip & flow lines: New flow and drip lines run where your plants need them.
- Backyard redos: Retaining walls, drainage fixes and full backyard makeovers.

## Service area
- St. George

## Questions customers ask
- **Do you lay sod?** Yes. Customers mention new sod laid and cut neatly around rock and plants.
- **Can you fix or install sprinklers?** Yes. Customers mention whole new sprinkler systems, revamped irrigation and zones tested and tuned.
- **Do you do drip lines?** Yes. One customer had new flow and drip lines run along with new sod.
- **Can you help with drainage?** Yes. One customer needed help with rainwater collecting on their property.
- **What areas do you serve?** We serve St. George and surrounding Washington County. Not sure if you're in range? Give us a call.
